req.title: Return POST request metadata
req.statement: The system shall respond to POST /post with JSON including url, args, headers, form, data, files, json and origin.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that POST /post returns HTTP 200 with a JSON body containing exactly the keys: url, args, headers, form, data, files, json, and origin. Tests are designed to: (1) verify the positive path with form data, (2) verify JSON body payload reflection, (3) verify query-string args reflection, (4) test the negative path with a wrong HTTP method (GET on /post), (5) test boundary of empty body, and (6) test exact key set presence. Each test uses exact-value assertions to maximize mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_post_url_field_contains_request_url
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
expected: url field is a non-empty string containing '/post'
trace: R-HTTPBIN-004: url key present and reflects endpoint
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_post_url_field_contains_request_url():
    r = client.post('/post')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert isinstance(body['url'], str)
    assert len(body['url']) > 0
    assert '/post' in body['url']
    assert 'origin' in body
    assert isinstance(body['origin'], str)

test_post_url_field_contains_request_url()

tests.name: test_post_headers_reflected_in_response
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: POST to /post with a custom header X-Test-Header: sentinel
expected: headers field contains X-Test-Header with value sentinel
trace: R-HTTPBIN-004: headers key reflects incoming request headers
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_post_headers_reflected_in_response():
    r = client.post('/post',
                    headers={'X-Test-Header': 'sentinel'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert isinstance(body['headers'], dict)
    headers_lower = {k.lower(): v for k, v in body['headers'].items()}
    assert headers_lower.get('x-test-header') == 'sentinel'

test_post_headers_reflected_in_response()

tests.name: test_post_content_type_json_sets_json_field_not_form
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: POST to /post with Content-Type application/json and body {"x": 99}
Assert json field equals {"x": 99} and form is empty
expected: data field equals the raw JSON string
trace: R-HTTPBIN-004: json and form are mutually exclusive for JSON content-type
tests.executable:
import json as _json
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_post_content_type_json_sets_json_field_not_form():
    payload_str = '{"x": 99}'
    r = client.post('/post',
                    data=payload_str,
                    content_type='application/json')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert body['json'] == {'x': 99}
    assert body['json']['x'] == 99
    assert body['form'] == {}
    assert body['data'] == payload_str

test_post_content_type_json_sets_json_field_not_form()
